payload.task_text:
You are a catering planner for a company team lunch event. The event is for 20 people with a budget of $25 per person. You need to plan a diverse menu, collect dietary preferences from attendees, document the menu, and track the budget.

Your task has four parts.

Part 1: Search the recipe database for 6 to 8 recipes suitable for a team lunch catering event. Select a mix of main dishes and side dishes. For each recipe, note the recipe name, category (such as meat, vegetable, staple, or similar), and estimated number of servings.

Part 2: Create a Google Forms survey titled "Team Lunch Dietary Preferences" to collect dietary information from the 20 attendees. The survey must contain at least 3 questions covering the following topics: dietary restrictions or preferences (such as vegetarian, vegan, nut allergy, gluten-free, or none), any specific food allergies to be aware of, and any additional comments or requests. Use appropriate question types for each question (for example, a multiple-choice question for dietary preferences, and short-answer text questions for allergies and comments).

Part 3: Create a Notion page titled "Team Lunch Menu" documenting the catering plan. The page must include a description of the event (20 people, $25 per person budget), a list of all selected recipes with their categories and serving information, and any notes about accommodating dietary restrictions.

Part 4: Create an Excel file called Catering_Budget.xlsx in the workspace with two sheets. The first sheet must be named "Menu" with the following columns in this exact order: Recipe_Name, Category, Servings, Estimated_Cost_Per_Person. Add one row for each of your selected recipes with a reasonable estimated cost per person. (You may append a "Total" summary row after the recipe rows if you wish; it is not counted as a recipe row.) The second sheet must be named "Summary" with two columns: Metric and Value. Include the following rows: Total_Dishes (number of recipes selected), Total_Budget (total budget for 20 people, which is 500), Budget_Per_Person (which is 25). Write every value in the Summary "Value" column and every Estimated_Cost_Per_Person as a literal number (for example, 500 and 25) — do not write Excel formulas for these cells.

The initial workspace contains Event_Brief.md describing the event details and requirements.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents. Read `Event_Brief.md`, create the fixed Google Form once, and query the necessary HowToCook categories with native-parallel read calls. Select one explicit set of 6–8 recipes containing mains and sides, retrieve only those selected recipes, and reuse exactly that set in both `Team Lunch Menu` and `Catering_Budget.xlsx`. The Form must contain a dietary-preference multiple-choice question plus text questions whose titles explicitly contain `allergy` and `additional comments or requests`. In the workbook, write the exact two sheets and headers, exactly one recipe row per selected dish, literal numeric per-person costs, and literal Summary values `Total_Dishes`, `500`, and `25`; do not use formulas. Create the Notion page and workbook as independent output branches after the recipe set is fixed, and verify the Form, page, and workbook once each.

nodes.text:
Create a single Notion page in the connected Notion workspace. This is a self-contained task; you need nothing else from me.

GOAL: Create a top-level Notion page titled exactly "Team Lunch Menu" (use the mcp__notion__API-post-page tool). Since the workspace has no existing pages, use the workspace as the parent: parent = {"type": "workspace", "workspace": true}. Page properties must set the title, e.g. properties = {"title": [{"text": {"content": "Team Lunch Menu"}}]}. Optionally set an emoji icon 🍽️.

IMPORTANT KNOWN ISSUE & HOW TO HANDLE IT: When calling mcp__notion__API-post-page, the object-typed parameters `parent` and `properties` may be rejected with a validation error like "/parent must be object ... /properties must be object" (the tool layer serializes them as strings). If that happens:
1. Retry with slightly different equivalent shapes (e.g. parent = {"workspace": true}, properties = {"title": "Team Lunch Menu"}; or properties with the full title rich-text array).
2. If post-page keeps failing, first try creating the page some other way if possible (e.g. mcp__notion__API-create-a-database has the same parent parameter — likely same issue).
3. Do NOT give up after one failure — try at least 4-5 different shape variants across separate calls before concluding.

PAGE CONTENT — create the page with these content blocks (children array). Use a table block for the recipe list; if table blocks fail, fall back to bulleted list items with the same information:

1. paragraph: "Company Team Lunch — Q1 team celebration and planning session. Buffet-style catering for 20 people with a total budget of $500 ($25 per person). Beverages are handled separately and are not included in this budget."
2. heading_2: "Event Details"
3. bulleted_list_item: "Attendees: 20 people"
4. bulleted_list_item: "Budget: $25 per person ($500 total)"
5. bulleted_list_item: "Format: Catered buffet-style lunch"
6. bulleted_list_item: "Occasion: Q1 team celebration and planning session"
7. heading_2: "Selected Recipes (8 dishes)"
8. paragraph: "All dishes are scaled to serve 20 — at a buffet each attendee takes a portion of every dish, so each dish is budgeted for 20 servings."
9. A 4-column table (header row: Recipe | Category | Dish Type | Servings) with these 8 data rows:
   - 可乐鸡翅 — Cola Chicken Wings | Meat (荤菜) | Main dish | 20
   - 糖醋里脊 — Sweet & Sour Pork Tenderloin | Meat (荤菜) | Main dish | 20
   - 咖喱肥牛 — Curry Beef Slices | Meat (荤菜) | Main dish | 20
   - 蒜蓉西兰花 — Garlic Broccoli | Vegetable (素菜) | Side dish | 20
   - 地三鲜 — Sautéed Potato, Eggplant & Green Pepper | Vegetable (素菜) | Side dish | 20
   - 凉拌黄瓜 — Smashed Cucumber Salad | Vegetable (素菜) | Side dish (cold appetizer) | 20
   - 扬州炒饭 — Yangzhou Fried Rice | Staple (主食) | Staple | 20
   - 西红柿鸡蛋汤 — Tomato & Egg Drop Soup | Soup (汤) | Soup | 20
   (Table block format: type "table" with table.table_width=4, table.has_column_header=true, and table.rows = array of table_row blocks, each {"type": "table_row", "table_row": {"cells": [[rich_text...], [rich_text...], [rich_text...], [rich_text...]]}} where each cell is an array containing one text rich_text object.)
10. heading_2: "Dietary Accommodation Notes"
11. bulleted_list_item: "Survey: Dietary preferences are collected from all 20 attendees via the \"Team Lunch Dietary Preferences\" Google Form (dietary restrictions multiple-choice, allergies short-answer, additional comments short-answer): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/da473b0f-3c27-49bb-b11a-5de8452b2c25/viewform — send it at least 5 days before the event."
12. bulleted_list_item: "Vegetarian / Vegan: Three vegetable sides (Garlic Broccoli, Di San Xian, Smashed Cucumber Salad) cover vegetarian attendees; they can be prepared vegan on request (skip oyster sauce in the broccoli and cucumber salad)."
13. bulleted_list_item: "Nut-free: No recipe on the current menu contains peanuts or tree nuts; keep the buffet nut-free unless survey responses say otherwise."
14. bulleted_list_item: "Gluten-free: Soy sauce, oyster sauce and curry blocks contain gluten — offer gluten-free tamari on the side and ensure plain steamed rice is available as a safe staple."
15. bulleted_list_item: "Allergy flags in the current menu: Yangzhou Fried Rice contains shrimp (shellfish) and egg; Tomato & Egg Drop Soup and fried rice contain egg; Curry Beef Slices contain dairy (milk). Final menu will be adjusted based on survey responses 3 days before the event."
16. bulleted_list_item: "Every dish will be labeled at the buffet with its main allergens. Questions: events@company.example.com"
17. heading_2: "Budget Snapshot"
18. bulleted_list_item: "Total budget: $500 (20 people × $25 per person)"
19. bulleted_list_item: "Estimated menu cost: $21.00 per person across 8 dishes ($420 total), leaving ~$80 buffer for delivery and setup."
20. bulleted_list_item: "Detailed cost breakdown tracked in Catering_Budget.xlsx (Menu + Summary sheets)."

You may create the page first with just the title and then append the blocks with mcp__notion__API-patch-block-children (page ID as block_id) if that is more reliable — patch-block-children's parameters are not $ref-typed and are less likely to hit the serialization issue. To verify success, retrieve the page (mcp__notion__API-retrieve-a-page) and/or its block children and confirm the title is exactly "Team Lunch Menu" and the content is present.

DELIVERABLE (report back): the created page ID, its URL, and confirmation that title + all sections (Event Details, Selected Recipes table/list with 8 dishes incl. categories and servings, Dietary Accommodation Notes, Budget Snapshot) are present. If creation is truly impossible after exhausting the retries above, report the exact error messages you received instead.
Create Notion Team Lunch Menu page
